title: [VSC-15] VS Code: account actions in the Accounts view, matching JetBrains
description:
Epic epic-aabc654d (VS Code works + plugin reuse), sliced by task-a3e414a3 (VSC-0). Depends on VSC-14 (task-720f81a6917d4490ab3b5a58c2217ccb: AccountsTreeProvider and the moe.accounts view), and through it on VSC-12's client senders and VSC-13's AccountPresentation port.

Objective: the actions of JetBrains' Accounts tab (moe-jetbrains AccountsPanel.kt, enabled by AccountPresentation.actions): add an account (label checked with isValidLabel; ADD_ACCOUNT, then sign it in), sign in an existing account, remove (after a confirmation), move up and down, rename, and set the switch percent. Sign-in runs the daemon's `accounts login <id>` in a terminal the way JetBrains does (TerminalAgentLauncher.accountsCommandLine and runAccountsCommand, with --accounts-file); in VS Code that is an integrated terminal (vscode.window.createTerminal plus sendText) running the bundled daemon (bundled/daemon/index.js, resolved the way AgentLauncher.ts resolves it). Enablement follows AccountPresentation.actions exactly, through context keys used in `when` clauses.

Deliverable: the commands, view/item/context menu entries and context keys in moe-vscode/package.json; their handlers in moe-vscode/src/providers/AccountsTreeProvider.ts, calling VSC-12's client senders; new moe-vscode/tests/accounts-actions.test.cjs. If the terminal command needs shell quoting, reuse the quoting moe-vscode/src/util/AgentLauncher.ts already has (it may become the fourth file).

Not in scope: VM token actions (AccountPresentation.vmTokenArgs; verified-local stays refused in this project), any moe-jetbrains file, the daemon.

Verification (GLOBAL rail: never npm in the shared checkout): `git archive HEAD` of the whole repo into a fresh directory outside the checkout, overlay this task's files, then in <snapshot>/moe-vscode run `npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run lint && npm run compile && npm test` under `env -i HOME=$HOME PATH=$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v24.21.0/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin` (mem:gotcha-vscode-gate-from-wsl).
definitionOfDone: moe-vscode/tests/accounts-actions.test.cjs asserts each action (add, sign in, remove, move up, move down, rename, switch percent) calls the matching client sender exactly once with the expected arguments after its input or confirmation, and zero times when the input is cancelled or isValidLabel rejects it.
For every rotation row in moe-jetbrains/src/test/resources/client-accounts.json, the context keys the provider sets match AccountPresentation.actions' enabled flags.

Sign-in opens one integrated terminal whose command runs the bundled daemon's `accounts login <id>` with the --accounts-file argument JetBrains passes, and the test proves an id or path containing spaces or quotes is quoted.
package.json declares every action command with view/item/context entries scoped to the moe.accounts view, asserted by the test.
In a git-archive snapshot of HEAD plus this diff, `cd moe-vscode && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run lint && npm run compile && npm test` exits 0 with 0 failures.

implementationPlan.note: Read landed VSC-12 (client senders/events match msg-a53702b5; moveAccount/setAccountSwitchPercent throw RangeError), VSC-13 AccountPresentation, VSC-14 provider (row contextValue 'moe.account', V1 pins it) and JetBrains AccountsPanel/TerminalAgentLauncher. Adaptations: tokens appended to VSC-14's 'moe.account' (not 'moeAccount') only once registerCommands() ran, so VSC-14's V1 stays valid untouched; onAccountAdded subscribed in registerCommands (VSC-14's fake client has no onAccountAdded); public contextFor(id) lets K2 check the selected id for every corpus row, including C09 where VSC-14 lists no rows while disconnected. New tests/accounts-actions.test.cjs (12 tests). RED in a HEAD snapshot (/tmp/vsc15-red-*): every test fails with 'provider.registerCommands is not a function'. 22 peer dirty paths untouched.

implementationPlan.description:
Terminal plumbing in moe-vscode/src/providers/AccountsTreeProvider.ts.
NOTE: this file is CREATED BY VSC-14 (task-720f81a6), which must be DONE before this row can be claimed. It sits under newFiles only because it did not exist at plan time. EDIT the landed file; never recreate or overwrite it.
Keep every new helper inside this file: no new value import, because the provider loads under strict require maps (epic notes; mem:gotcha-vscode-panel-strict-require-map).
- Copy psQuote, shQuote and assertSafeArg from moe-vscode/src/util/AgentLauncher.ts as private functions, with a comment naming that source.
- Export `accountsCommandLine(cli: {node: string; script: string}, registryFile: string, args: string[], windows: boolean): string`:
  - the words are [cli.node, cli.script, '--accounts-file', registryFile, ...args], as in JetBrains TerminalAgentLauncher.buildAccountsCommand;
  - every word passes assertSafeArg;
  - windows: inner = '& ' + words.map(psQuote).join(' ') and return `powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -EncodedCommand ${Buffer.from(inner, 'utf16le').toString('base64')}`, AgentLauncher's injection-safe form;
  - otherwise words.map(shQuote).join(' ').
- The CLI is the daemon's own (rotation.cli: its node binary and dist/accounts/cli.js, inside bundled/daemon when VS Code spawned the daemon) with --accounts-file rotation.registryFile, as JetBrains passes them.
- `private runCli(args)`: parse the client's rotation; do nothing without one or without its cli. Build the line with process.platform === 'win32', then `vscode.window.createTerminal({ name: TERMINAL_TAB })`, sendText(line) and show().
- Error handling: an assertSafeArg throw shows vscode.window.showErrorMessage and opens no terminal. A createTerminal throw copies the line with vscode.env.clipboard.writeText and shows a warning with TERMINAL_UNAVAILABLE ({0} = line), as JetBrains does.
- Text constants copied exactly from moe-jetbrains/src/main/resources/messages/MoeBundle.properties: ADD_TITLE, ADD_PROMPT, RENAME_TITLE, RENAME_PROMPT, REMOVE_CONFIRM ({0}), REMOVE_SIGN_OUT, REMOVE_ONLY, TERMINAL_TAB, TERMINAL_UNAVAILABLE (with its newline), SWITCH_AT and SWITCH_AT_UNIT. Format them with a one-pass `/\{(\d+)\}/g` function replace.
implementationPlan.note: Edited VSC-14's landed AccountsTreeProvider.ts with the Edit tool (not recreated). Copied psQuote/shQuote/assertSafeArg from AgentLauncher.ts (comment names the source); exported accountsCommandLine(cli, registryFile, args, windows) in TerminalAgentLauncher.buildAccountsCommand word order (bash single quotes; Windows `& '...'` in -EncodedCommand utf16le base64). Private runCli uses rotation.cli + registryFile, process.platform === 'win32', createTerminal({name: TERMINAL_TAB}) + sendText + show; a createTerminal throw copies the line to the clipboard and warns with terminal.unavailable; an assertSafeArg throw reaches the handler guard -> showErrorMessage, no terminal. Exported ACCOUNT_ACTION_TEXT holds the 11 bundle values; `say` formats with one-pass /\{(\d+)\}/g. No new value import: only actions and isValidLabel were added to the existing AccountPresentation import (+ an import type for AccountActions).

implementationPlan.description:
Action handlers in moe-vscode/src/providers/AccountsTreeProvider.ts, as public methods taking the element.
- Every handler re-reads FRESH state: rotation = parseAccountRotation(client.accountRotation), connected = client.connectionState === 'connected' and allowed = actions(rotation, accountId, connected). It returns quietly when its flag is false, because a menu can be stale.
- NOT_CONNECTED = 'Not connected to Moe daemon — the account change was not sent.' is shown whenever a sender returns false.
- add():
  - showInputBox({title: ADD_TITLE, prompt: ADD_PROMPT, value: '', validateInput: v => isValidLabel(v) ? undefined : 'Use at most 64 characters and no control characters.'});
  - a cancel or an invalid label sends nothing;
  - otherwise set awaitingAdd = true and call client.addAccount(label); on false, reset awaitingAdd and warn;
  - subscribe once in the constructor to client.onAccountAdded: when awaitingAdd, reset it and runCli(['login', id]), as JetBrains AccountsPanel.onAccountAdded does. Dispose that subscription in dispose().
- signIn(element): runCli(['login', id]).
- remove(element):
  - choices = ['Sign out and remove' if allowed.signOutAndRemove] + ['Remove only' if allowed.removeOnly];
  - showWarningMessage(REMOVE_CONFIRM with the account label, {modal: true}, ...choices);
  - 'Remove only' calls client.removeAccount(id); 'Sign out and remove' calls runCli(['remove', id, '--sign-out']); a dismiss does nothing.
- moveUp/moveDown(element): client.moveAccount(id, -1 / 1).
- rename(element): showInputBox({title: RENAME_TITLE, prompt: RENAME_PROMPT, value: current label, validateInput as above}). A cancel, an invalid label or trimmed === current label sends nothing; otherwise client.renameAccount(id, label).
- setSwitchPercent(): showInputBox({title: SWITCH_AT, prompt: '1-100' + SWITCH_AT_UNIT, value: String(rotation.switchAtPercent), validateInput: /^\d+$/ and 1..100, else 'Enter a whole number from 1 to 100.'}). A cancel, an invalid value or the current value sends nothing; otherwise client.setAccountSwitchPercent(n).
- Error handling: wrap each handler body in try/catch and call showErrorMessage(`Account action failed: ${message}`) on an unexpected throw.
implementationPlan.note: Handlers add/signIn/remove/move(-1|1)/rename/setSwitchPercent, each inside guard() (try/catch -> showErrorMessage 'Account action failed: <msg>'). Every handler re-reads fresh actions() before asking AND again after the input/confirm, before it sends. NOT_CONNECTED warning whenever a sender returns false; add sets awaitingAdd = the sender's result. remove offers Sign out and remove / Remove only per allowed flags in a modal showWarningMessage (C11, with no CLI, offers Remove only). rename skips cancel/invalid/trimmed-unchanged and sends '' (architect note 2). setSwitchPercent: whole 1..100, skips the current value. Deviations: (1) handlers are private and reached through the registered command callbacks, which is what the tests drive, rather than public methods; (2) the onAccountAdded subscription is made in registerCommands(), not the constructor, because VSC-14's accounts-view fake client has no onAccountAdded. It is still disposed in dispose(), through the same subscriptions array. ACCOUNT_ADDED runs login directly under awaitingAdd, without the signIn gate (architect note 4).

implementationPlan.description:
Enablement and registration.
- In moe-vscode/src/providers/AccountsTreeProvider.ts:
  - give every account element `contextValue = ['moeAccount', ...tokens].join(' ')`. The tokens canRename, canMoveUp, canMoveDown, canRemove (removeOnly || signOutAndRemove) and canSignIn come from actions(rotation, element id, connected), computed wherever VSC-14 builds the elements;
  - add `registerCommands(): vscode.Disposable[]`. It registers moe.accounts.add, .signIn, .remove, .moveUp, .moveDown, .rename and .setSwitchPercent to the handlers, and installs a hook so every refresh (onAccountsChanged, onConnectionChanged, construction) runs `vscode.commands.executeCommand('setContext', 'moe.accounts.canAdd', a.add)` and the same for 'moe.accounts.canSwitchAt', where a = actions(rotation, null, connected);
  - before registerCommands() runs, the provider never touches vscode.commands, so VSC-14's accounts-view.test.cjs fake stays valid.
- In moe-vscode/src/extension.ts, next to VSC-14's provider registration: `context.subscriptions.push(...accounts.registerCommands());`, using the landed variable name.
- Error handling: a rejected setContext promise is caught and ignored (it is cosmetic). registerCommands may run only once; a second call throws an Error naming the provider.
- If VSC-14's accounts-view.test.cjs pins the full element shape and breaks on contextValue, set contextValue where that test does not look. Edit that test only if it is unavoidable, minimally, and say so in the summary.
implementationPlan.note: Element contextValue = contextFor(row.id): 'moe.account' (VSC-14's landed value, not the plan's 'moeAccount') plus the tokens canSignIn/canRename/canMoveUp/canMoveDown/canRemove(removeOnly||signOutAndRemove) from fresh actions(rotation, id, connected). Tokens are added only after registerCommands() ran, so VSC-14's V1 (`contextValue === 'moe.account'`) holds and accounts-view.test.cjs is NOT edited. registerCommands() registers exactly the seven ids, subscribes onAccountAdded, then refresh(). refresh() now also runs publish(), which setContexts moe.accounts.canAdd and canSwitchAt from actions(rotation, null, connected) when registered, on every client event. A rejected setContext is caught and ignored. A second call, or a call after dispose, throws an Error naming AccountsTreeProvider. extension.ts gets one line after VSC-14's push: `context.subscriptions.push(...accountsProvider.registerCommands());` (VSC-14's X1 regex still matches its own line). Snapshot run: accounts-actions 12/12, accounts-view 9/9, accounts-corpus 5/5; lint 0, compile 0.

implementationPlan.note: package.json: 7 commands (category 'Moe Accounts'; first six titles = MoeBundle moe.accounts.button.*; add $(add), setSwitchPercent $(settings-gear)); view/title add (navigation@2, `view == moe.accounts && moe.accounts.canAdd`) and setSwitchPercent (navigation@3, `... && moe.accounts.canSwitchAt`) after VSC-14's refresh (navigation@1); new view/item/context with signIn/rename/moveUp/moveDown/remove, each `view == moe.accounts && viewItem =~ /\\bcanX\\b/`, groups 1_accounts@1..5; new commandPalette hiding all seven (`when: false`). comments.author: architect-0fcb7226
comments.content:
From architect-0fcb7226, planner of VSC-12. Interface check for step 1. This changes no plan step.

VSC-12 landed in fbc38d15. It matches msg-a53702b5 by name and type, so use the names as written. Four details:

1. Two senders throw RangeError before sending instead of returning false. moveAccount does it on any offset other than ±1. setAccountSwitchPercent does it on a non-integer or a value outside 1..100. Keep the validateInput checks and the literal ±1, and don't test for false on these two.
2. renameAccount sends a cleared label as ''. That is JetBrains parity: isValidLabel accepts empty, which means "show the id". Don't add a blank refusal.
3. onAccountsChanged fires on every STATE_SNAPSHOT, including unchanged or undefined ones, and on every accepted ACCOUNTS_UPDATED. Keep the setContext refresh idempotent.
4. The daemon sends ACCOUNTS_UPDATED, already listing the new account, BEFORE ACCOUNT_ADDED. The comment at MoeDaemonClient.ts:1590 states that order backwards, but the file is outside this row's files, so leave it alone. Call runCli(['login', id]) directly from onAccountAdded under awaitingAdd, as step 3 says. Don't route it through the signIn actions() gate.

Full notes are in the #architects reply to msg-a53702b5 (msg-68634ee8).

executionContract.intendedBehavior: The VS Code Accounts view gains JetBrains' account actions: add (label checked by isValidLabel, then sign-in of the new account from ACCOUNT_ADDED), sign in, remove (Remove only, or Sign out and remove through the CLI, after a modal confirmation), move up and down, rename, and set the switch percent. Sign-in and sign-out-remove run the daemon's own accounts CLI in an integrated terminal with --accounts-file, with every word shell-quoted. Enablement follows AccountPresentation.actions through the setContext keys moe.accounts.canAdd and canSwitchAt and per-item contextValue tokens.
acceptanceCriteria: Each action calls its client sender exactly once with JetBrains' arguments after input or confirmation, and zero times on a cancel, an invalid label, an unchanged value or a dismiss; a false return shows the pinned not-connected warning.
For every client-accounts.json row, canAdd/canSwitchAt equal expectActions.add/switchAt, and the selected element's tokens equal the mapped expectActions flags.
Sign-in opens one terminal running `<node> <cli.js> --accounts-file <file> login <id>`; spaces and quotes are quoted for bash and PowerShell (-EncodedCommand); CR, LF or NUL is refused.

No vscode.commands call before registerCommands(); VSC-14's accounts-view.test.cjs stays valid (an edit only as a named, minimal fallback).
Senders run only after explicit input or confirmation and a fresh actions() check.
MoeDaemonClient.ts, AccountPresentation.ts, every moe-jetbrains file and the corpus are unchanged; VM token actions stay out of scope.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: Sign-in uses rotation.cli, the daemon's own node and accounts CLI, as JetBrains does, rather than a separately resolved bundled/daemon/index.js. When VS Code spawned the daemon, that CLI is the bundled daemon's. It always matches the serving daemon, it needs no node on PATH, and actions().signIn already gates on cli. Quoting helpers are copied, not imported, because of the closed require maps. registerCommands() keeps vscode.commands out of construction and refresh, so VSC-14's tests stay untouched. Remove offers both JetBrains choices, so the shared remove.confirm text stays truthful. AccountsTreeProvider.ts appears under newFiles in step 2 only because VSC-14 had not created it at plan time; the worker edits the landed file.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: The ManagedVmTreeProvider precedent sets context keys with setContext and uses enablement. View/item menus pass the element to the command callback. Java properties values decode `\n` to a newline, so terminal.unavailable needs that decoding in the test. The Buffer global must be supplied to a vm.createContext harness for the base64 encoding.
planningNotes.risks: VSC-12 and VSC-14 were still being planned when this plan was written. The interfaces above were posted to their architects (msg-a53702b5); follow the landed code where it differs, keeping the behaviour contract. A missing onAccountAdded would leave add without its sign-in follow-up; then comment on VSC-12 and ask the governor before inventing a protocol. extension.ts and package.json are shared files: in shared-checkout mode, do not run concurrently with rows editing them. HEAD can carry a peer's red wip checkpoint (mem:gotcha-snapshot-gate-peer-wip-checkpoint).
